correctness.rationale: For the repaired claim in repairs/5/RESULT.md. The literal frozen Finding that every support rank is uniquely optimal on an interval is false: k=1 gives a product state with zero negativity, so either it loses or all ranks tie. The repair preserves that frozen evidence and restricts unique optima to 2,…,d, explicitly treating k=1. Independently expanding the tensor-product channels gives the ideal term, the two one-side mixing terms with the reduced projector P_k/k, and pq I/d². The partial transpose pairs only ij and ji in the support; in each pair its diagonal h is the sum of the mixing terms and its off-diagonal g=(1-p)(1-q)/k. The possible negative eigenvalue contributes [g-h]_+=[Δ-kΠ]_+/(kd²); summing k(k-1)/2 pairs gives the exact formula, also zero when k=1. Other eigenvalues are nonnegative. For Π>0 and Δ>2Π rank two is positive, so maximizing the truncated score is equivalent to maximizing the untruncated score, whose first differences Δ-2kΠ strictly decrease. This proves exactly the adjacent ties, with no positive tie at k=1. Δ≤2Π yields an all-zero tie, and Π=0 reduces to a nonnegative linear score in k-1. With symmetric noise, x=d(1-t)/t and Δ/Π=x²-2x strictly decreases in t in the positive region; solving x²-2x=2k gives correctly ordered, distinct switches and each entangled rank a nonempty interval. The death and full-support endpoints follow from Δ=2Π and Δ=dΠ respectively. For d=3 and p=q=1/2 the exact pair (Δ,Π)=(3/4,1/4) gives (N2,N3)=(1/72,0). The repaired statement, proof and boundary cases were reread. The verification notes and spectral checker remain scientifically compatible (the interval check already loops over k=2 through d), and no uploaded script was run.
residual_risks: The optimum is only among uniform-on-support pure inputs; no global optimality or general equivalence of PPT and separability is claimed.

evidence: Theorem 7 characterizes PPT-inducing and entanglement-annihilating maps by γ≤α+β+2 for positive maps of its family. For pq>0, rescaling the independent product channel by d²/pq puts its coefficients in that form and gives exactly Δ≤2Π. The theorem includes a rank-two witness to necessity.
Corollary 8 yields the symmetric endpoint t=d/(d+1+√3) in the frozen convention; the local-qubit robustness source cannot exhibit multiple entangled support ranks.
broader_coverage.reasoning: The broader all-input theorem covers vanishing of the best negativity, also for unequal nonzero noise, but gives no magnitude ordering within its positive region.

value.rationale: The repaired result answers a concrete resource-allocation question for the standard controlled-shift conversion under physically independent local noise. Maximal initial entanglement need not maximize surviving negativity: the exact transitions identify every regime, and the rational qutrit witness shows full-support negativity already zero while smaller support remains NPT. The familiar all-input death threshold alone cannot answer which entangled support to choose at lesser noise.
residual_risks: These exact optima justify decisions within the flat-support family only; no advantage over all other input classes is inferred.
